data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 第一杯还没碰完的笑话
data.description: 居酒屋吧台前，阳乃穿墨绿高领毛衣和黑色长裙，举起半杯啤酒正要碰杯，忽然被自己的笑话逗笑。她另一手扶着杯垫，眼角微弯，暖灯照见的是卸下社交礼数后的轻松。
data.action: 举起半杯啤酒，扶着杯垫被自己的笑话逗笑。
data.mood: 成年人的余裕、微醺放纵
data.promptProse: Haruno raises a half-filled beer mug at the izakaya counter and laughs softly at her own joke, free hand steadying the coaster beside supper. Her covering forest-green turtleneck, calf-length black skirt and silver studs accompany amused eyes beneath the black bob. The seated medium view follows the counter into the evening interior. Warm counter light shines through the beer and catches her earrings, casting mug and plate shadows across the wood.
